# Freelankarx

> Premium digital execution brand helping ambitious businesses create websites, Shopify stores, AI automation, business automation, task bots, email marketing, social media marketing, SEO, resume writing, LinkedIn optimization, UI/UX design, and reputation management.

## About

Freelankarx is a one-person premium digital studio led by Olamilekan Muraina, based in Lagos, Nigeria, serving clients in 15+ countries worldwide.

Founded on the philosophy that businesses deserve digital experiences that don't just look beautiful but create real growth, trust, and transformation.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://freelankarx.com/services/web-development/): Custom websites and web applications
- [Shopify Development](https://freelankarx.com/services/shopify-development/): Custom stores and conversion optimization
- [AI Automation](https://freelankarx.com/services/ai-automation/): Chatbots, workflow automation, AI agents
- [Shopify SEO](https://freelankarx.com/services/shopify-seo/): Technical SEO, content optimization, link building
- [Resume Writing](https://freelankarx.com/services/resume-writing/): Executive resumes, ATS optimization
- [UI/UX Design](https://freelankarx.com/services/ui-ux-design/): User research, wireframing, prototypes

## Target Audience

Small to medium business owners, ecommerce brands, startups and entrepreneurs, agencies and consultants, personal brands and professionals.

## Pricing

Project-based starting at $300 (resume writing). Retainer services starting at $300/month (maintenance). Premium services $1,500 to $6,000+. Custom quotes available.

## Geographic Reach

Headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Serving clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, and the Middle East.
